dialogues.speaker: Hanayama Kaoru
dialogues.text: Hey...I'm so glad you're here... It's like this, after you gave me the flower seeds, I started planting flowers.

dialogues.speaker: Hanayama Kaoru
dialogues.text: But before I could plant much, a group of monsters suddenly appeared and kept loitering around the place where I was going to plant the flowers. I no longer dare to go over to plant them.

dialogues.speaker: Hanayama Kaoru
dialogues.text: If they continue to remain here, they may destroy the place where the flowers were planted...

dialogues.speaker: Hanayama Kaoru
dialogues.text: If you don't mind, could you go and get rid of those monsters for me? I... I just want to plant flowers...

response.speaker: Hanayama Kaoru
response.text: You said yes? Thank you so much! I'm counting on you!

choices.text: Why are you so determined on growing flowers?

response.speaker: Hanayama Kaoru
response.text: I was thinking, the reason why people don't want to come back to Tatarasuna is because they are worried that this place is no longer suitable for living after the Mikage Furnace incident happened...

response.speaker: Hanayama Kaoru
response.text: I can't persuade everyone one by one, but if I can plant a lot of beautiful flowers here again...

response.speaker: Hanayama Kaoru
response.text: Maybe it will be enough to convince everyone that Tatarasuna is already safe.

response.speaker: Hanayama Kaoru
response.text: And...heh, besides planting flowers, I have no other means to convince people...

response.speaker: Hanayama Kaoru
response.text: So please, please help me to chase away those monsters!

dialogues.speaker: Hanayama Kaoru
dialogues.text: Have you managed to chase away those monsters?

dialogues.speaker: Hanayama Kaoru
dialogues.text: Have you managed to chase away those monsters?

dialogues.speaker: Hanayama Kaoru
dialogues.text: Thank you, now I can continue to grow flowers...

dialogues.speaker: Hanayama Kaoru
dialogues.text: Oh yes, please take these, I'm sorry I don't have anything nice for you... Anyway, thanks for helping me out!

dialogues.speaker: Hanayama Kaoru
dialogues.text: There are still a lot of seeds not planted... I need to work harder...
